title_en: Good News (11/20): A Record Number of Trees
note_en: 不管…都… means "no matter…, still…": the 不管 clause lists the possibilities, and 都 in the main clause says the result holds for all of them. 不管是农民还是学生，不管年纪大小，大家都参加了 "Whether they were farmers or students, young or old, everyone took part." Note that inside 不管 you need a choice (还是, 大小) or a question word; you can't say 不管 + a single plain noun.
